title: mw.audit.event.v1
description: AuditEvent (spec 14.3). Every service produces it; mw-audit-dw consumes and owns it. Key: txnId or actor id. Payloads are masked before publishing (spec 18.3); raw bodies go to audit.payload via payloadRef.

action.description: Stable action name, e.g. txn.state.changed, config.updated.

before.description: Masked state before an operator action.

after.description: Masked state after an operator action.

hop.description: Ticket 130 (FRS AUD-01, AUD-04): which hop of a transaction this event records, for the per-hop timeline. Absent: mw-audit-dw infers it from the action (txn.state.changed and txn.operator.action ORCHESTRATOR, partner.call.completed PARTNER_CALL, partner.callback.* PARTNER_CALLBACK).

direction.description: Ticket 130: the hop's direction seen from the middleware: IN = a request the middleware received (channel request, partner callback), OUT = a call the middleware made (core, partner, SMSC).

durationMs.description: Ticket 130: latency of the hop (request to answer), in milliseconds.

payload.description: Ticket 130 (FRS AUD-01, CON-04): the hop's bodies, masked by the producer (MaskingPolicy; never a PIN, PAN or clear MSISDN/NID); mw-audit-dw scrubs them again and stores them in audit.payload, inside the hash chain. A body may be an excerpt whose full masked text is behind payloadRef (an adapter's partner_payload store, ticket 97).

direction.description: IN = received by the middleware (a request it served, a partner's answer), OUT = sent by it.
